cards.title: Status notes, built
cards.text: Charm, Confused, Sleepy, Fear, the ghost, the bite, the Succubus, the hunters, poison. Live as 0.20.0.
cards.why: Each part is one of your notes with a clip of it. Mark any that still plays wrong. Bleeding's new look is the next card.
cards.details:
Calls I made that you didn't specify:

- Mini-bosses count as bosses for charm: none of them can be charmed. An Enchantress party beats fewer Foundry mini-bosses because of it (9 in 12 runs, was 12). Say if you meant only the final bosses.
- A follower stays until it dies or the floor ends, so nobody collects followers across a whole dungeon. In tests one turns up in about 1 Enchantress run in 6.
- A battle side's last unit, and the party's last hero standing, are still only stunned by charm, not turned.
- Poison drops to 20 when the sickness ends, and never rises to 20 if it was lower.

Weak spots: Sleepy's longer wind-ups are hard to see in a clip (the numbers are in its part). Fear's spread has no drawn radius; you see it in the friends sweating, backing off and running.

parts.title: Charm: the last enemy
parts.text: Bosses can't be charmed. A room's last enemy, charmed, wins the room and walks on with the party as a follower, fighting for them in the next rooms. Several charmed at once all follow; what a charmed summoner calls up is charmed too.

parts.title: Confused
parts.text: It swings round to random headings and walks that way. Swirls pop up on its body while it builds; question marks when it bursts. Burst: abilities go off one at a time at random moments, not all at once.

parts.title: Sleepy: wind-ups
parts.text: Every wind-up and charge takes up to 40% longer as it fills: a rattler's swing 0.42 s to 0.57, a banshee's wail 0.58 to 0.82, the Archer's Barrage 0.42 to 0.57. The designed bosses' own move timers are not stretched.

parts.title: Fear
parts.text: From the first point it backs away, facing what scared it. Burst: it turns and runs. A terrified unit frightens friends near it, weaker at each hand it passes through, so a pack panics for 6 or 7 seconds and then settles.

parts.title: Ghost: sleepy
parts.text: The ghost's touch makes heroes sleepy instead of cursing them.

parts.title: The bite
parts.text: The jaws show wide open first, then snap, turned 90 degrees. Rats, bats and hunter spiders use it. Wolves and hounds draw a thrust instead and are unchanged.

parts.title: Succubus: a cooldown
parts.text: Struck, she answers with one kiss that charms the attacker, then can't again for 4 seconds, whoever hits her. She wins about as often as before.

parts.title: Healer hunters
parts.text: Every few seconds a hunter rolls even odds on going for the healer. Hunter spiders spent 85% of their time on a Bard; now 60%. Hellhounds were already near chance: their pack picks the target.

cards.title: Bleeding: pick a look
cards.text: You didn't like the look at all. The red wash, cuts and drops are gone; here are three different ones.
cards.why: Tick the one to keep, or none and say what's off. The first is in the game until you pick.

items.label: 1 Spurts
items.text: Drops squirt from a wound in time with a heartbeat and splash on the floor.

items.label: 2 Trail
items.text: A pool grows under the unit and it leaves a trail where it walks.

items.label: 3 Drop
items.text: Nothing on the floor: a drop beside the health bar fills like a gauge.
